grant_type.description: Type of access requested. To refresh the tokens, use "refresh_token"

wm_refresh_token.description: Worker Management Refresh token to be refreshed. Can be blank if the Connect token is provided.

connect_refresh_token.description: Connect Refresh token to be refreshed. Can be blank if the WM token is provided.

user.description: User ID linked to the refresh token. Required if a WM Token is provided
